purpose: Six real MuJoCo workstations matching the agreed A1-C2 diagrams; static preparation only

coordinate_convention.world: +X robot facing forward / 后; -X toward robot / 前; +Y 左; -Y 右; +Z 上
coordinate_convention.angles: radians in MJCF and reset state; degrees in page and *_deg fields
coordinate_convention.valve: local pipe +X, stem +Z; clockwise closing about stem uses axis 0 0 -1; q=0 open, q=pi/2 closed
coordinate_convention.workstation_layout: A/B/C three rows at X=0.58/2.13/3.68 m; case 1/2 at Y=0/-1.30 m; all face -X

robot.model: OpenArm v1 official bimanual fixed upper body
robot.ready_pose: official arm home posture; both arms in front, no contact with A1; pedestal support, no legs or climbing

valve.provenance: Bray catalogue size and torque references retained; handle cross section, bends, inertia, friction, installation height and station spacing are task assumptions. No real measurement or force trial this run.
